column1: # Context settings of the Chonk trainer, by maximum length (prompt plus answer). run.sh takes the first row whose
# max_tokens is at least the task's `context:` (50K gets the 64K row) and refuses a longer context.
#   cp        Megatron context_parallel_size: each GPU holds pack_tokens / cp tokens of a micro-batch (8,192 here)
#   scheme    head: the pinned Megatron splits the 28 KDA heads over the CP ranks (CP 1, 2 or 4)
#             kcp:  KDA context parallelism (backends/nemo-rl/apertus2/kcp, Megatron-LM-MoE PR 112), tokens stay
#                   split, any CP that divides the ranks of a pipeline stage
#   pack      sequence-packing budget of a micro-batch (train and log-prob)
#   memfrac   NRL_CUDA_MEMORY_FRACTION: PyTorch's share of a trainer GPU; the rest is NCCL, Triton and CUDA
# Measured on 16 trainer nodes (PP2, EP16) in docs/long-context.md: 32K at CP4 peaks at 8,192 tokens
# per GPU; CP2 also fits at 32K (60.1 GB), not compared for speed yet.
